Packages and Releases

Pahlevan publishes three artifacts per release: a container image, a Helm chart, and a single-file Kubernetes manifest. Release notes live in CHANGELOG.md and on the GitHub releases page.

Container image

The image is published to the GitHub Container Registry:

ghcr.io/obsernetics/pahlevan
Tag Meaning
latest Most recent build of the default branch
v3.3.3 Immutable release tag (recommended for production)
main Rolling tag for the default branch
main-<sha> Per-commit build of the default branch, useful for bisecting 
docker pull ghcr.io/obsernetics/pahlevan:v3.3.3

One image ships all three binaries:

  • pahlevan-agent - the privileged DaemonSet that loads and attaches the eBPF programs and enforces locally in the kernel.
  • pahlevan-operator - the leader-elected Deployment that drives policy lifecycle, aggregates status, and owns admission.
  • pahlevan - the CLI.

The runtime layer is distroless: no shell, no package manager, and no userland beyond the binaries themselves.

Verifying the image

docker pull ghcr.io/obsernetics/pahlevan:v3.3.3

# Inspect the manifest, digest, architecture, and labels
docker inspect ghcr.io/obsernetics/pahlevan:v3.3.3

# Digest only (pin this in air-gapped or regulated environments)
docker inspect --format '{{index .RepoDigests 0}}' ghcr.io/obsernetics/pahlevan:v3.3.3

# Confirm the entrypoints exist without a shell in the image
docker run --rm --entrypoint /pahlevan-operator ghcr.io/obsernetics/pahlevan:v3.3.3 --help

Pin by digest rather than by tag when you need a byte-for-byte reproducible deployment:

image: ghcr.io/obsernetics/pahlevan@sha256:<digest>

Helm chart

The chart is served from the project's GitHub Pages site.

helm repo add pahlevan https://obsernetics.github.io/pahlevan/charts
helm repo update
helm install pahlevan pahlevan/pahlevan-operator \
  -n pahlevan-system --create-namespace

Useful overrides:

helm install pahlevan pahlevan/pahlevan-operator \
  -n pahlevan-system --create-namespace \
  --set image.repository=ghcr.io/obsernetics/pahlevan \
  --set image.tag=v3.3.3

Show the resolved values and the available versions:

helm search repo pahlevan --versions
helm show values pahlevan/pahlevan-operator

Uninstall:

helm uninstall pahlevan -n pahlevan-system

CRDs are not removed by helm uninstall. Delete them explicitly if you want a clean slate:

kubectl delete crd pahlevanpolicies.policy.pahlevan.io \
  containerprofiles.policy.pahlevan.io \
  attacksurfaces.policy.pahlevan.io

Raw manifest

For clusters without Helm, each release attaches a rendered install.yaml containing the CRDs, RBAC, the operator Deployment, and the agent DaemonSet:

kubectl apply -f https://github.com/obsernetics/pahlevan/releases/latest/download/install.yaml

Pin to a specific release instead of latest:

kubectl apply -f https://github.com/obsernetics/pahlevan/releases/download/v3.3.3/install.yaml

Review before applying:

curl -sSL https://github.com/obsernetics/pahlevan/releases/download/v3.3.3/install.yaml | less

After installing

Verify both workloads are up, then apply a policy:

kubectl -n pahlevan-system get pods
kubectl get crd | grep pahlevan.io

See quick-start.md for the first PahlevanPolicy, and system-requirements.md plus lsm-support.md for the kernel prerequisites of in-kernel enforcement.

Pahlevan

eBPF-powered runtime security for Kubernetes. Self-learning workload baselines, enforced in-kernel - no hand-written rules.
